mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-01.title: Total distance ÷ total time
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-01.body:
Distance: $106 + 174 = 280$ miles. Time: $\frac{106}{58} \approx 1.8276$ h plus $3.2$ h $= 5.0276$ h. Speed: $280 \div 5.0276 \approx 55.7$ mph.

**Answer: 55.7 mph**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-02.title: Time remaining
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-02.body:
DC → Duck took $\frac{106}{58} + 3.2 \approx 5.0276$ h. Duck → Williamsburg: $126 \div 54 \approx 2.3333$ h. Time left: $5.0276 - 2.3333 = 2.6943$ h. Speed: $153 \div 2.6943 \approx 56.8 \approx 57$ mph.

**Answer: 57 mph**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-02.title: Fractions
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-02.body:
Total time $\frac{729}{145}$ h; first leg $\frac{7}{3}$ h. Remaining: $\frac{729}{145} - \frac73 = \frac{2187 - 1015}{435} = \frac{1172}{435}$ h. Speed $= 153 \cdot \frac{435}{1172} \approx 56.79 \approx 57$ mph.

**Answer: 57 mph**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-03.title: Actual minus planned
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-03.body:
Planned Williamsburg → DC time: total DC → Duck time $\frac{106}{58} + 3.2 \approx 5.0276$ h minus Duck → Williamsburg $126/54 \approx 2.3333$ h $= 2.6943$ h.
Actual: $\frac{20}{45} + \frac{10}{30} + \frac{123}{57} \approx 0.4444 + 0.3333 + 2.1579 = 2.9356$ h.
Added: $2.9356 - 2.6943 = 0.2413$ h $\approx 0.2413 \times 60 \approx 14.5$ minutes.

**Answer: 14.5 minutes**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-03.title: Work in minutes
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-24-03.body:
Planned: $2.69425 \times 60 \approx 161.66$ min. Actual: road work $\frac{20}{45} \cdot 60 + \frac{10}{30} \cdot 60 = 26.67 + 20 = 46.67$ min, plus $\frac{123}{57} \cdot 60 \approx 129.47$ min, total $\approx 176.14$ min. Added $\approx 176.14 - 161.66 \approx 14.5$ min.

**Answer: 14.5 minutes**
